assessments.reasoning: Printed pp. 35–36 show declared argument names separated from body expressions, single-keyword evaluation, and the two-keyword form. Printed p. 36 explicitly matches the count of value: keywords to declared block arguments and binds the supplied values in order.

challenge.method: Compare the one-argument size example, the two-argument frame and clipping role example, the mismatched arity sentence, and unary evaluation on printed p. 32.
challenge.results: The example adds 3, 2 and 2 to reach 7 for successive one-argument sends. The first and second values in the two-argument example are associated with the first and second roles respectively. The mismatch sentence describes an error without defining its class or delivery, and the unary branch is a separate selector.

limitations: Only documented keyword-family evaluation of a block with declared arguments is covered. The mismatch diagnostic, unary evaluation, and collection protocols are separate scopes.
